name: wordle-teams-v2
//packageManager: v2 pins its own pnpm rather than inheriting the root's, per the island rule in the v2 design: no shared lockfile, no root tooling changes. The root pins 11.13.0, which pnpm has since marked a BROKEN RELEASE — its @pnpm/exe build shipped without a binary, so CI's self-installer refuses it outright (ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_PNPM_RELEASE).

scripts.//generate-routes: REMOVED. `tsr generate` standalone strips the Register block from routeTree.gen.ts, including the startInstance registration that wires the Sentry global middlewares — and the vite plugin silently writes it back on the next dev/build, so the damage only shows if you commit in between. The plugin in vite.config.ts is the only generator; there is nothing to run by hand. See wt-ksh.1.15.
scripts.//build: The service worker is built AFTER vite, not by it. vite-plugin-pwa cannot emit anything in this repo — @cloudflare/vite-plugin makes `vite build` a multi-environment build that resolves ssr last, which pins build.ssr=true, and the plugin's closeBundle guards on `!build.ssr`. It exits 0 and writes no sw.js. scripts/build-sw.mjs bundles src/sw.ts with esbuild, injects the precache manifest with workbox-build, writes dist/client/sw.js, and FAILS LOUDLY if any of that did not happen. See spike S3 and the header comment in that script.
